# YT6 — Azure Copilot Integration

## Integration Goals
- clarity evaluation inside Copilot workflows
- drift detection for Copilot agents
- reproducibility testing for enterprise Copilot deployments

## Integration Methods
1. Azure AI Studio project
2. Copilot Studio agent
3. MCP server for clarity evaluation
4. Azure Functions for automated scoring

## Required Components
- YT6 datasets
- YT6 scoring rules
- YT6 reproduction system
- YT6 logs
